method: Stage pools use explicit fixture IDs backed by the saved source schedule; no free-text stage parsing.
Completed stage-pool games are candidates, not automatic official selections; outside-pool and unfinished games stay excluded from candidate arithmetic.
Raw totals retain every provider score, including zeros and unlisted identities; no threshold/role-based exclusion.
Map-sheet mean comparison uses floor(sum(positive scores)/positive count) as a diagnostic supported by most saved cells, not an approved player-statistics formula.
Team Fail is recorded in rules but cannot be determined from this reduced snapshot; no raw winner is rewritten.
Accuracy, combo and hit counts were not captured and remain null; candidate counts are never claimed as complete import/publication acceptance.
